book_name: 华研外语听力场景词汇库

words.ex: He goes out without a coat and catches a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他出去时没穿外套，结果感冒了。
words.en: To become ill with a cold.

words.ex: He has a common cold and stays home from school.
words.ex_cn: 他得了普通感冒，待在家里没去上学。
words.en: The common cold is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract that primarily affects the nose.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.ex: The nurse takes her temperature every morning.
words.ex_cn: 护士每天早上给她量体温。
words.en: To measure someone's body temperature, usually to check for fever.

words.ex: The nurse will take your blood pressure.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给你量血压。
words.en: To measure the pressure of the blood in someone's arteries, especially as a way of checking their health.

words.ex: He got yellow fever while traveling in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他在非洲旅行时感染了黄热病。
words.en: Yellow fever is a serious viral disease that is transmitted by mosquitoes, primarily in tropical regions of Africa and South America. It is characterized by fever, chills, severe headache, back pain, general body aches, nausea, and vomiting. In severe cases, it can cause liver damage leading to jaundice (which gives the disease its name), bleeding, and even death.

words.ex: He has a bad lung infection.
words.ex_cn: 他得了严重的肺部感染。
words.en: Your lungs are the two organs inside your chest which fill with air when you breathe in.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.ex: He has heart disease and must eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他患有心脏病，必须吃健康的食物。
words.en: A condition that affects the heart and blood vessels, often leading to serious health issues.

words.ex: He had a heart attack last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周心脏病发作。
words.en: A heart attack occurs when the flow of blood to the heart is blocked, usually by a blood clot.

words.ex: The doctor checked his pulse with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手指检查了他的脉搏。
words.en: A pulse is the regular beating of the heart, especially when it is felt at the wrist or neck. It can also refer to a single vibration or short burst of sound, electric current, light, etc.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.ex: He injured his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example in an accident or an attack.

words.tr: adj. 受伤的；受损害的； v. “injure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The injured player was taken to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 受伤的球员被送往医院。
words.en: If you are injured, you have been hurt, usually in an accident or attack.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口正在流血。
words.en: When you bleed, blood flows from your body, usually because you are injured.

words.tr: v. 擦伤；挫伤；出现伤痕；
words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.ex: He twisted his ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: The joint between the foot and the leg, in which movement occurs in two planes.

words.ex: The accident was fatal.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是致命的。
words.en: If an action or event is fatal, it causes someone's death.

words.ex: The snake has a deadly bite.
words.ex_cn: 这种蛇的咬伤是致命的。
words.en: If something is deadly, it is likely or able to cause someone's death, or has already caused someone's death.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.tr: adj. 头晕目眩的；头昏眼花的；
words.ex: He felt dizzy after spinning around quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

words.ex: I have a sore throat, so I cannot speak loudly.
words.ex_cn: 我喉咙痛，所以不能大声说话。
words.en: To experience pain or discomfort in the throat.

words.ex: He has a stuffy nose because of the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感冒而鼻塞。
words.en: A condition in which the nasal passages are blocked, often due to a cold or allergies.

words.tr: phrase. 流鼻涕；鼻涕直流的状况
words.ex: He has a running nose because of the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感冒而流鼻涕。
words.en: A condition in which mucus is produced and flows from the nose, often due to a cold or allergy.

words.tr:
n. 喷嚏；喷嚏声
v. 打喷嚏
words.ex: He had a cold and let out a loud sneeze.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，打了一个响亮的喷嚏。
words.en: To sneeze is to suddenly expel air from the nose and mouth due to irritation in the nasal passages.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.ex: The virus can infect people quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒能迅速感染人。
words.en: To infect someone or something means to cause them to have a disease or illness.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.ex: Children are susceptible to colds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子容易感冒。
words.en: If you are susceptible to something or someone, you are very likely to be influenced by them.

words.ex: He is overweight because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他超重是因为吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: If someone is overweight, they weigh more than is considered healthy or attractive.

words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.tr: phrase. 精神疾病；心理疾病
words.ex: He suffers from mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他患有精神疾病。
words.en: A mental illness is a condition that affects a person's thinking, feeling, behavior or mood. These conditions deeply impact day-to-day living and may also affect the ability to relate to others.

words.tr: phrase. 心理健康；精神状态
words.ex: He cares about his mental health every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很关心自己的心理健康。
words.en: Mental health refers to the state of one's psychological and emotional well-being.

words.ex: The nerve in his finger was damaged.
words.ex_cn: 他手指里的神经受到了损伤。
words.en: A nerve is a bundle of fibers that transmits impulses of sensation to the brain or spinal cord, and impulses from these to the muscles and organs. It also refers to the courage or control needed to do something difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: He has sleeplessness because of too much stress.
words.ex_cn: 他因为压力太大而失眠。
words.en: The condition of being unable to sleep.

words.ex: The accident left him with a serious trauma on his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他的腿受了严重的伤。
words.en: A trauma is a very distressing or disturbing experience.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: He is a medical practitioner who helps sick people.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名帮助病人的医生。
words.en: A qualified professional who practices medicine.

words.ex: He had a consultation with the doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他与医生进行了一次咨询。
words.en: A consultation is a meeting which is held to discuss something. Consultation is discussion about something that is still being planned.

words.ex: He needs to see a doctor for his cough.
words.ex_cn: 他需要去看医生治咳嗽。
words.en: To visit a doctor for medical advice or treatment.

words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预约医生。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation at a specific time.

words.tr: phrase. 健康中心；医疗中心
words.ex: I go to the health center for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 我去健康中心做体检。
words.en: A health center is a place where people can receive medical care, health education, and other health-related services. It often serves as the primary point of contact for individuals seeking health services in a community.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 急诊室；急救室（医院中专门处理紧急医疗情况的部门）
words.ex: He went to the emergency room after falling down.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后去了急诊室。
words.en: A hospital department that provides immediate treatment for acute illnesses and trauma.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.ex: The doctor can diagnose the illness quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生能很快诊断出这种病。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.ex: The doctor made a diagnosis after checking the symptoms.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查了症状后做出了诊断。
words.en: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

words.tr: phrase. 医学检查结果；体检报告
words.ex: The doctor showed him the medical result.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他看了检查结果。
words.en: The outcome or findings from a medical examination or test.

words.ex: The police will examine the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查犯罪现场。
words.en: If you examine something, you look at it carefully.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.ex: The doctor gave a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了药方。
words.en: To issue a written order for medication or treatment from a doctor.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He bought medicine at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在药店买了药。
words.en: A drugstore is a shop where medicines and other small items are sold.

words.ex: The chemist discovered a new element.
words.ex_cn: 这位化学家发现了一种新元素。
words.en: A chemist is a scientist who specializes in chemistry, or in some contexts, a person who is qualified to prepare and dispense drugs and medicines.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: He took a painkiller for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: A painkiller is a drug that reduces or removes physical pain.

words.tr: n. 副作用; 附带后果
words.ex: The medicine has a small side-effect.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有一个小的副作用。
words.en: An effect of a drug or medical treatment that is in addition to its intended effect, especially an effect that is harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: He uses eye drops when his eyes are itchy.
words.ex_cn: 当他的眼睛发痒时，他会使用眼药水。
words.en: A liquid medicine that is administered into the eyes to treat various eye conditions or to moisturize dry eyes.

words.tr: n. 阿司匹林（镇痛解热消炎药）
words.ex: He took aspirin for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了阿司匹林来缓解头痛。
words.en: Aspirin is a common drug that is used to reduce pain and inflammation.

words.ex: The nurse will inject medicine into his arm.
words.ex_cn: 护士将把药水注入他的手臂。
words.en: To inject a substance such as a medicine or drug means to put it into someone's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an injection for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An injection is the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: He will have an operation next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要做手术。
words.en: Undergo a medical procedure performed by a surgeon.

words.ex: He tried to curb his horse with the reins.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用缰绳勒住马。
words.en: If you curb something, you control it and keep it within limits.

words.ex: The wound will heal in a few days.
words.ex_cn: 伤口几天后就会愈合。
words.en: To make or become healthy or whole again; to cure or recover from an injury or illness.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.tr: v. 恢复；重新获得；复原；
words.ex: He will recover from the illness soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会从疾病中恢复。
words.en: If you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again. If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 检查；核查；（尤指为发现疾病或问题而）进行健康检查
words.ex: The doctor will check up on you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给你做检查。
words.en: To examine something or someone in order to discover if there are any problems or to find out more information.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.ex: Tourists visit the beach in peak season.
words.ex_cn: 游客在旺季去海滩。
words.en: The period of the year when demand for a particular product or service is at its highest.

words.tr: phrase. 淡季；旅游或商业活动较少的时期
words.ex: The hotel is cheap in low season.
words.ex_cn: 淡季时酒店很便宜。
words.en: The period of the year when a business or tourist destination is least busy and prices are usually lower.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 不在旺季的；不合时令的；反季节的；过季的
words.ex: The apples are out of season now.
words.ex_cn: 现在苹果不是应季水果。
words.en: Not available or not at the best time of year; not in season.

words.tr: phrase. 旅游季节；游客旺季
words.ex: Hotels are full during tourist season.
words.ex_cn: 旅游旺季时，酒店都住满了。
words.en: The period of the year when a place is most visited by tourists, often due to favorable weather or events.

words.ex: We went to the beach during summer vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在暑假去了海滩。
words.en: A period of time in the summer when schools and colleges are closed and students and teachers have a holiday.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.tr: phrase. 进行一次旅行；出行；出远门
words.ex: They will make a trip to the beach next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周将去海滩旅行。
words.en: To go on a journey or excursion.

words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.ex: The tour guide showed us the old castle.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古老的城堡。
words.en: A tour guide is a person who leads groups of people around a town, museum, or other tourist attraction, providing information about the place.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr: phrase. 度假者；假日旅游的人
words.ex: The holiday maker took photos at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 这位度假者在海滩上拍照。
words.en: A person who travels for leisure or vacation, especially during a public holiday period.

words.tr:
n. 乘船游览；航游；
v. 乘船游览；航游；
words.ex: We went on a cruise around the Mediterranean Sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘船游览了地中海。
words.en: To sail about in an area without a precise destination, especially for pleasure.

words.tr:
n. 远足；郊游；短途旅行
v. 使熄灭；揭露；驱逐；“out”的现在分词
words.ex: We went on a school outing last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去学校组织的郊游了。
words.en: An outing is a short trip that you go on for pleasure or education, often with a group of people.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.tr:
n. 远足；
v. 远足；
words.ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山里进行了一次长途远足。
words.en: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure. It can also refer to an increase in the cost or amount of something.

words.tr: v. <美><口>作搭便车式的旅行；<美><口>作搭便车式的旅行( hitchhike的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He went hitchhiking across the country last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他搭便车横穿了全国。
words.en: Hitchhiking is the activity of getting free rides from passing vehicles, usually by standing at the side of a road and signaling to drivers.

words.ex: The backpacker walked through the mountains with a big bag.
words.ex_cn: 那个背包客背着一个大包穿越了山脉。
words.en: A backpacker is someone who travels or hikes carrying their belongings in a backpack.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.tr: phrase. 紧急联系人；在紧急情况下可联系的人员
words.ex: He wrote his emergency contact person on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他在表格上写了紧急联系人。
words.en: A person designated to be contacted in case of an emergency, such as a family member or close friend.

words.ex: He called the emergency telephone number when the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 当汽车撞车时，他拨打了紧急电话号码。
words.en: An emergency telephone number is a dedicated hotline, like 911 or 112, for contacting immediate assistance in crises.

words.tr: phrase. 指南书；旅游手册；导览书
words.ex: He uses a guide book to find the museum.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本指南书找博物馆。
words.en: A guide book is a book that provides information for tourists or visitors about a place, including maps, recommendations, and tips.

words.tr: phrase. 旅游宣传册；游客手册
words.ex: The tourist brochure shows the beach and hotels.
words.ex_cn: 这本旅游手册展示了海滩和酒店。
words.en: A tourist brochure is a small book or magazine containing pictures and information about a place, designed to attract tourists.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.ex: He takes public transport to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transport refers to the system of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.ex: The passenger got off the bus at the next stop.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅客在下一站下了车。
words.en: A passenger is a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not the driver or one of the people who works on it.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: I took a cab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A cab is a taxi, a vehicle that carries passengers for a fare, usually calculated by a meter.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.ex: The express train arrives in 10 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 特快列车10分钟后到达。
words.en: An express train is a fast train that stops at few stations and is intended for passengers who wish to travel quickly between major cities.

words.ex: He drives on the expressway every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走高速公路。
words.en: An expressway is a wide road that allows traffic to move quickly from one place to another, especially between cities.

words.tr: n. 小路；小巷；航道；车道；航线；
words.ex: The children walked down the narrow lane to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们沿着狭窄的小路去上学。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. It can also refer to a division of a road intended to separate lines of traffic moving in the same or opposite directions.

words.ex: He walks to the railway station every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去火车站。
words.en: A railway station is a place where trains stop so that people can get on or off.

words.ex: He bought a train ticket at the ticket office.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张火车票。
words.en: A ticket office is a place where tickets are sold to the public for admission to a theater, for travel on public transportation, etc.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: The train runs on the railway.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: He takes the metro to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A metro is an underground railway system in a city.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭载某人一程；让某人搭便车
words.ex: He gave me a lift to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他载我去车站。
words.en: To take someone somewhere in your car, especially when they need help getting there.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车租赁；租车服务
words.ex: We booked a car rental for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了汽车租赁。
words.en: The service of renting cars for a short period of time, usually ranging from a few hours to a few weeks.

words.ex: He got his driving licence last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving licence is an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles on public roads.

words.ex: Drivers must obey the traffic rule to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 司机必须遵守交通规则以确保安全。
words.en: To follow the regulations governing vehicle movement on roads to ensure safety and order.

words.ex: He breaks the traffic rule by driving too fast.
words.ex_cn: 他因为开得太快而违反了交通规则。
words.en: To violate traffic regulations.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.ex: He was late because of a traffic jam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: A traffic jam is a long line of vehicles that cannot move forward because there is too much traffic, or because the road is blocked by something.

words.ex: The traffic is heavy during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通很拥堵。
words.en: The rush hour is one of the periods of the day when most people are travelling to or from work.

words.ex: The traffic flow is slow during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通流量很慢。
words.en: The movement of vehicles or pedestrians along a street or other route.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: He stopped at the gas station to fill his car.
words.ex_cn: 他停在加油站给车加油。
words.en: A gas station is a place where fuel is sold for motor vehicles.

words.tr: phrase. 停放汽车；把汽车停好
words.ex: He can park a car near the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他可以把车停在商店附近。
words.en: To position a vehicle in a specific place, typically for parking.

words.ex: The airline lost my luggage.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司弄丢了我的行李。
words.en: An airline is a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: The flight number is 234.
words.ex_cn: 航班号是234。
words.en: A flight number is the specific code assigned to a particular flight by an airline, consisting of the airline's code followed by a numerical identifier.

words.tr: phrase. 出发时间；离港时间
words.ex: The departure time is 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 出发时间是早上8点。
words.en: The scheduled time at which a vehicle, especially a train, bus, or aircraft, is supposed to leave a place.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: They passed the security check at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他们在机场通过了安全检查。
words.en: A security check is a process of verifying the identity and ensuring the safety of individuals by inspecting them and their belongings before allowing access to a secure area.

words.tr: phrase. 一流的；头等舱；第一类邮件；第一堂课
words.ex: He got a first class result in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了一流的成绩。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as first class, you mean that they are extremely good and of the highest quality.

words.ex: He flew in business class to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐商务舱飞行以节省时间。
words.en: Business class refers to a high-quality travel class available on some airlines and rail lines, offering more comfortable seating, better food, and more amenities than economy class.

words.ex: He booked an economy class ticket for the flight.
words.ex_cn: 他为航班预订了经济舱机票。
words.en: Economy class is the cheapest type of seats in a plane or train.

words.ex: He bought a single ticket to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张音乐会的单程票。
words.en: A ticket for a journey to a place but not back again.

words.ex: He bought a return ticket to London.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张去伦敦的往返票。
words.en: A return ticket is a ticket for a journey to a place and back again.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr: phrase. 到达某人的目的地
words.ex: They arrive at their destination late at night.
words.ex_cn: 他们深夜到达目的地。
words.en: To reach the place one is traveling to.

words.tr: phrase. 历史遗迹；具有历史意义的地点
words.ex: This old temple is a history spot from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙是古代的历史遗迹。
words.en: A location or site of historical significance or interest.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: They went to a holiday resort last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年夏天去了一家度假胜地。
words.en: A place, often in a scenic or coastal area, where people go for relaxation and recreation during holidays.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: We saw lions and elephants in the safari park.
words.ex_cn: 我们在野生动物园看到了狮子和大象。
words.en: A safari park is a park where wild animals are kept in large enclosures for the public to see, often allowing visitors to drive through in their own vehicles.

words.tr: phrase. 植物园；专门用于种植和展示各种植物的园区
words.ex: We walked in the botanical garden and saw many flowers.
words.ex_cn: 我们在植物园里散步，看到了许多花。
words.en: A botanical garden is a place where plants are grown for scientific study and display to the public.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: We planned our itinerary before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行前规划了路线。
words.en: An itinerary is a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you will visit.

words.ex: The city built a road map for new buses.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市为新公交车绘制了一张道路图。
words.en: A road map is a plan or strategy intended to achieve a particular goal.

words.tr: phrase. 路线图；路线示意图；行动指南；计划蓝图
words.ex: He used a route map to find the way to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用路线图找到了去公园的路。
words.en: A route map is a detailed plan or diagram showing the route to be taken on a journey, or the sequence of steps in a process.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去露营；去野营
words.ex: They go camping every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天去露营。
words.en: To go camping means to spend a holiday living in a tent, usually in the countryside.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: He packed his sleeping bag for the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为露营旅行打包了睡袋。
words.en: A sleeping bag is a warmly lined or padded bag for sleeping in, especially outdoors.

words.tr: phrase. 蚊子叮咬；被蚊子咬后的肿块
words.ex: He scratched his arm after a mosquito bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被蚊子叮了之后抓了胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito bite is the result of a mosquito piercing the skin to feed on blood, often causing itching and swelling.

words.tr: phrase. 急救箱；用于处理轻微伤害或紧急情况的医疗用品包
words.ex: I keep a first aid kit in my car.
words.ex_cn: 我把603急救箱放在车里。
words.en: A first aid kit is a collection of supplies and equipment that is used to give medical treatment.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: We went to a theme park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了一家主题公园。
words.en: A theme park is a type of amusement park that bases its structures and attractions around a central theme, often featuring multiple areas with different themes.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: We stayed at a small inn near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在山附近的一家小客栈里。
words.en: A small hotel, usually in the countryside, where you can stay the night and have meals.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.ex: The students stayed in a youth hostel during their trip.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在旅行期间住在青年旅舍。
words.en: A youth hostel is a place where young people, especially those who are traveling, can stay cheaply for short periods of time. It usually provides dormitory-style accommodation and shared facilities.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.tr: phrase. 登记入住；预约登记
words.ex: I will book in for a hotel room tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预订一个酒店房间。
words.en: To reserve a place or accommodation, especially in a hotel or for an event.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 结账离开（旅馆等）；登记离店
words.ex: We booked out of the hotel at 11 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们在上午11点结账离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out or leave a place, such as a hotel or library, after completing a stay or borrowing period.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr:
n. 书；账簿；
v. 预订；
words.ex: I read a book before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 我睡觉前读了一本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard. Books contain information, stories, or poetry, for example.

words.ex: He finished his homework ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了作业。
words.en: If you do something ahead of time, you do it before a particular event or before you need to, often in order to save time later.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.ex: I will make a reservation for two people.
words.ex_cn: 我将为两个人预订。
words.en: To book or arrange for something in advance, such as a table at a restaurant.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.ex: He ordered room service because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了就点了客房服务。
words.en: Room service is a service provided by a hotel in which food and drink are brought to guests' rooms.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.tr: phrase. 海外留学生；来自国外的学生
words.ex: The overseas student lives in a dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这名海外学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student who comes from a foreign country to study in another country.

words.tr: n. 寄宿处； v. “lodge”的现在分词；
words.ex: He found cheap lodging near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 他在火车站附近找到了便宜的寄宿处。
words.en: Lodging refers to a place to live or stay, especially temporarily.

words.tr: n. 出租的房舍；住所；寄宿舍；“lodging”的复数
words.ex: He found cheap lodgings near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他在车站附近找到了便宜的住宿。
words.en: Rooms or a room rented to live in.

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.tr: phrase. 寄宿家庭；接待留学生的家庭
words.ex: I live with a host family in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 我在加拿大和一个寄宿家庭住在一起。
words.en: A family that provides accommodation and meals for a student or traveler, often in exchange for payment or as part of a cultural exchange program.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.tr: phrase. 市中心区域；城市中心地带
words.ex: He walks to the downtown area every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去市中心。
words.en: The central part of a city, typically the commercial and cultural hub.

words.tr: adv. （用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方；
words.ex: I don't know his whereabouts.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他在什么地方。
words.en: The place where someone or something is.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.tr: phrase. 地产经纪人；地产管理人；土地代理人
words.ex: The land agent helped them buy a farm.
words.ex_cn: 土地代理人帮助他们买了一个农场。
words.en: A person employed to manage the affairs and property of a landowner.

words.tr: phrase. 住在校外；不在学校宿舍居住
words.ex: He lives off campus near the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园外，靠近公交站。
words.en: To reside in a place that is not part of the university or college campus.

words.tr: phrase. 住在校园内；在校内住宿
words.ex: He lives on campus with his roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和室友住在校园里。
words.en: To reside within the premises of an educational institution, typically a college or university, for the duration of one's studies.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍
words.ex: He lives in the hall of residence near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在图书馆附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: A hall of residence is a building where students live at a university or college.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: He lives in a residential college near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园附近的一所住宿学院里。
words.en: A residential college is a college that provides accommodation for students, typically on or near the campus of a university.

words.tr: n. 看门的人；门卫；门厅侍者
words.ex: The doorman opened the door for the guest.
words.ex_cn: 门卫为客人打开了门。
words.en: A doorman is a person whose job is to stand at the door of a building such as a hotel and help people who are going in or out.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: He sits on the porch and drinks coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在门廊上喝咖啡。
words.en: A porch is a covered shelter projecting in front of the entrance of a building.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: The new house has a spacious living room.
words.ex_cn: 这所新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。
words.en: A spacious room, building, or place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.tr: phrase. 混乱；一团糟；陷于窘境
words.ex: His room is in a mess.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间乱七八糟。
words.en: If something is in a mess, it is in a state of confusion or disorder.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: The children play in the backyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在后院玩耍。
words.en: A backyard is an area of land at the back of a house, often used for recreation or gardening.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在底层。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼（在英式英语中指二楼，美式英语中指地面层以上的第一层）
words.ex: My office is on the first floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的办公室在一楼。
words.en: In British English, the first floor is the floor of a building which is one level above the ground floor. In American English, the first floor is the same as the ground floor.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.tr: v. 满足需要；“cater”的现在分词； n. 包办饮食；
words.ex: The new service is catering to the needs of students.
words.ex_cn: 这项新服务正在满足学生的需求。
words.en: The business of providing food and drink for events or occasions.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: They are relaxing in the sitting room.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在客厅里放松。
words.en: A room in a house where people sit and relax, often containing comfortable chairs and a television.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.ex: She heated the food in the microwave.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在微波炉里加热。
words.en: A microwave is a type of oven that cooks or heats food very quickly by using electromagnetic waves rather than heat.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.ex: He turned on the air-conditioner to cool the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了空调来让房间凉快。
words.en: An air-conditioner is a machine that keeps the air in a building cool and dry.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: She does the laundry every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日洗衣服。
words.en: To wash clothes, sheets, and other items using a washing machine or by hand.

words.ex: She uses the washing machine every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都用洗衣机。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other items.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: She washed the bed-linen every week.
words.ex_cn: 她每周都洗床单被套。
words.en: Bed-linen refers to the sheets, pillowcases, and other items used on a bed.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；“furnish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 配备家具的；
words.ex: They furnished the apartment with new tables and chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他们给公寓布置了新的桌椅。
words.en: If a room or building is furnished, it is equipped with furniture.

words.tr: n. 家具陈设；室内陈设品；
words.ex: The room has simple furnishings.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有简单的家具陈设。
words.en: The articles of furniture and other items that are used to make a room or building suitable for living or working in.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: He turned on the light bulb.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了灯泡。
words.en: A light bulb is an electric lamp which produces light by heating a filament or gas inside a glass bulb.

words.ex: He switches on the light when it gets dark.
words.ex_cn: 天黑时，他打开灯。
words.en: To turn on an electrical device by operating a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 关掉；不再想…；不考虑
words.ex: Please switch off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 你离开前请关掉灯。
words.en: To turn off an electrical device by using a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 公用事业账单（如水、电、燃气等费用账单）
words.ex: He pays his utility bills every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付水电费。
words.en: Utility bills refer to the invoices received for essential services such as electricity, water, and gas, which are necessary for a household or business.

words.ex: Let me help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 让我帮你做作业。
words.en: To allow or permit something to happen or someone to do something.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.tr: phrase. 一份租赁合同；租约，指出租人与承租人之间就租赁财产（如房屋、车辆等）所签订的法律协议
words.ex: He signed a rental contract for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租赁合同。
words.en: A legal agreement for renting property or equipment.

words.ex: They signed an agreement to share the costs.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份分担费用的协议。
words.en: An agreement is a formal decision about future action which is made by two or more people, groups, or organizations.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车租赁；汽车租用
words.ex: He signed a car lease for two years.
words.ex_cn: 他签订了一份为期两年的汽车租赁合同。
words.en: A car lease is a contract by which one party conveys property, in this case, a car, to another for a specified time, usually in return for a periodic payment.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: They will move in next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周搬进来。
words.en: To begin living in a new home or place.

words.ex: He will move out next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要搬出去。
words.en: To leave a place where you have been living and go to live somewhere else.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: He enjoys a sun bath on the beach every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都喜欢在海滩上晒日光浴。
words.en: The act of sitting or lying in the sun, especially to tan the skin.

words.tr: n. （拼写错误，正确拼写应为 'cirrus'）卷云；高云
words.ex: Cirus is a name from a fantasy story.
words.ex_cn: Cirus 是一个奇幻故事中的名字。
words.en: A misspelling of 'circus', a traveling show with performances, acrobats, and animals.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.tr: phrase. 电脑游戏；电子游戏
words.ex: He plays computer games every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上玩电脑游戏。
words.en: Computer games are games played on a computer, either alone or with others, for entertainment.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.ex: The museum displayed many beautiful artworks.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了许多精美的艺术品。
words.en: Artwork refers to the pieces of art that are produced by artists, including paintings, sculptures, and other forms of visual art.

words.tr: phrase. 现代雕塑；现代派雕塑艺术
words.ex: He likes modern sculpture in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢公园里的现代雕塑。
words.en: A form of artistic expression created in the 20th and 21st centuries, often using unconventional materials and focusing on abstract or conceptual ideas.

words.ex: He loves creating oil painting on canvas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在画布上创作油画艺术。
words.en: An oil painting is a picture that has been painted using oil paints.

words.tr: phrase. 美术馆；艺术博物馆
words.ex: We visited an art museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一家艺术博物馆。
words.en: An art museum is a building where works of art are displayed to the public.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.ex: The conductor raised his baton to start the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，开始演奏交响乐。
words.en: A conductor is a person who directs the performance of an orchestra or choir, or a substance that allows heat or electricity to pass through it.

words.tr: phrase. 现场音乐会；现场演唱会
words.ex: We went to a live concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了现场音乐会。
words.en: A live concert is a musical performance given in front of an audience, as opposed to a recorded performance.

words.ex: He loves to listen to folk music on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末听民谣音乐。
words.en: Folk music is music that originates in traditional popular culture or that is written in such a style. Folk music is typically of unknown authorship and is transmitted orally from generation to generation.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical music refers to the art music produced or rooted in the traditions of Western culture, including both liturgical (religious) and secular music.

words.ex: He listens to pop music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听流行音乐。
words.en: Pop music is a genre of popular music that originated in its modern form during the mid-1950s in the United States and the United Kingdom.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.tr: phrase. 摇滚乐；摇滚音乐（一种以电吉他、贝斯和鼓为主要乐器，节奏强烈、富有活力的流行音乐形式）
words.ex: He listens to rock music every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都听摇滚音乐。
words.en: Rock music is a genre of popular music that originated as 'rock and roll' in the United States in the 1950s, and developed into a range of different styles in the 1960s and later.

words.tr: n. 布鲁斯音乐；蓝色；“blue”的复数；
words.ex: He plays the blues on his guitar every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用吉他演奏布鲁斯音乐。
words.en: A type of slow, sad music, originally from the southern US, in which the singer typically sings about their difficult life or bad luck in love.

words.tr: phrase. 轻音乐；轻快的音乐
words.ex: He listens to light music before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前听轻音乐。
words.en: Light music refers to a genre of music that is primarily designed to be relaxing and easy to listen to, often characterized by its simple melodies and harmonies.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr: phrase. 去剧院（观看演出、电影等）
words.ex: They go to the theater on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末去剧院。
words.en: To attend a performance, such as a play, musical, or opera, at a theatre.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.tr:
n. 街舞；嘻哈文化
adj. 嘻哈的；嘻哈文化的
words.ex: He practices hip-hop every evening after school.
words.ex_cn: 他每天放学后都练习街舞。
words.en: Hip-hop is a cultural movement that began in the 1970s among African Americans and Latino youths in New York City, encompassing music, dance, art, and fashion.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: He read a literary work by Mark Twain.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一篇马克·吐温的文学作品。
words.en: A creative work, such as a book, poem, or play, that is valued for its artistic or intellectual qualities.

words.ex: He likes to read fiction and poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡觉前读小说和诗歌。
words.en: Literary works that are invented by the imagination, including novels, stories, and poems.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.tr: n. 航海；帆船运动； v. 航行；“sail”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves sailing on the open sea.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱在公海上航海。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving across water in a boat that is propelled by the wind.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.tr: n. 慢跑； v. “jog”的现在分词；
words.ex: He goes jogging every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去慢跑。
words.en: Jogging is the activity of running at a slow, regular speed, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: He loves mountain climbing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去登山。
words.en: The activity or sport of climbing mountains.

words.ex: He loves rock climbing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末攀岩。
words.en: Rock climbing is the sport or activity of climbing steep rock surfaces, especially with the help of ropes and special equipment.

words.tr: phrase. 蹦极跳；一种从高处跳下并靠弹性绳索反弹的极限运动
words.ex: He tried bungee jumping last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他上周末尝试了蹦极。
words.en: Bungee jumping is an activity that involves jumping from a tall structure while connected to a large elastic cord.

words.tr: adj. 有冒险精神的；敢于创新的；
words.ex: He is an adventurous boy who loves climbing mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢爬山的有冒险精神的男孩。
words.en: Willing to take risks or to try out new methods, ideas, or experiences.

words.tr: n. 滑雪（运动）； v. “ski”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves skiing in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山上滑雪。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving over snow on skis.

words.tr: n. 溜冰； v. “skate”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves skating on the frozen lake.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在结冰的湖面上溜冰。
words.en: Skating is the activity of moving on ice or a smooth surface using skates.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.tr: n. 乒乓球运动；桌球（一种在桌上进行的乒乓球游戏）
words.ex: He plays table-tennis after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后打乒乓球。
words.en: A sport played on a table with a net, using small paddles and a lightweight ball, also known as ping-pong.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打排球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.ex: The baseball team won the game yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 棒球队昨天赢了比赛。
words.en: A group of players who compete together in the sport of baseball.

words.ex: He plays basketball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打篮球。
words.en: A game played between two teams of five players in which goals are scored by throwing a ball through a netted hoop fixed above each end of the court.

words.tr: n. 保龄球； v. “bowl”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves playing bowling on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末打保龄球。
words.en: Bowling is a game in which you roll a heavy ball down a long, narrow track towards a group of wooden objects called pins, trying to knock down as many of them as possible.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: He works out at the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在健身房锻炼。
words.en: To engage in physical exercise at a fitness centre or gym.

words.ex: He runs every morning to keep fit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain one's health and physical condition through regular exercise and a healthy diet.

words.tr: phrase. 健身俱乐部；健身中心
words.ex: He goes to the fitness club every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身俱乐部。
words.en: A facility where people go to exercise, use gym equipment, and participate in fitness classes, often requiring a membership fee.

words.tr: phrase. 健身设施；健身场所
words.ex: The gym has new fitness facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这家健身房有新的健身设施。
words.en: Fitness facilities refer to the equipment and spaces provided for physical exercise and activities aimed at improving health and fitness.

words.ex: He paid a membership fee to join the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了一笔会员费来加入健身房。
words.en: A regular payment made to gain access to a service or facility, such as a gym or club.

words.ex: He pays an annual fee to use the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付年费以使用健身房。
words.en: A fee that is charged once per year for the use of a service or membership.

words.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家大公司的顾问。
words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.ex: He is a fitness trainer who helps people get stronger.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名健身教练，帮助人们变得更强壮。
words.en: A professional who provides instruction and guidance in physical exercise and fitness at a gym or similar facility.

words.tr: phrase. 私人教练；私人健身教练
